paragraphs.en: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app ( iOS , Android ), web app and Electron-based desktop app .
paragraphs.zh: T3 Code 是一个「智能体操控面板」。 它让你能够通过一流的手机应用（iOS、Android）、网页应用以及基于 Electron 的桌面应用，控制你机器上的智能体。

sents.en: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface".
sents.zh: T3 Code 是一个「智能体操控面板」。

sents.en: It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app ( iOS , Android ), web app and Electron-based desktop app .
sents.zh: 它让你能够通过一流的手机应用（iOS、Android）、网页应用以及基于 Electron 的桌面应用，控制你机器上的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.
paragraphs.zh: 支持你在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Google Antigravity 上的订阅。 如果它们已在你电脑上设置好，T3 Code 就能控制它们。

sents.en: Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity.
sents.zh: 支持你在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Google Antigravity 上的订阅。

sents.en: If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.
sents.zh: 如果它们已在你电脑上设置好，T3 Code 就能控制它们。

paragraphs.en: Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.
paragraphs.zh: 无。 我们构建 T3 Code，是因为我们想要获得与智能体协作的最佳开发体验。 我们从现有方案中获得了启发，例如 Codex 桌面应用、Conductor、Claude Desktop 和 Cursor Glass，但它们都不符合我们的标准。

sents.en: Nothing.
sents.zh: 无。

sents.en: We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents.
sents.zh: 我们构建 T3 Code，是因为我们想要获得与智能体协作的最佳开发体验。

sents.en: We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.
sents.zh: 我们从现有方案中获得了启发，例如 Codex 桌面应用、Conductor、Claude Desktop 和 Cursor Glass，但它们都不符合我们的标准。

paragraphs.en: We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want.
paragraphs.zh: 我们想要一个高性能、支持远程办公、并且真正开放的产品。 如果我们走错了方向，我们希望你拥有分叉（fork）并打造你想要的编辑器所需的一切。

sents.en: We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open.
sents.zh: 我们想要一个高性能、支持远程办公、并且真正开放的产品。

sents.en: If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want.
sents.zh: 如果我们走错了方向，我们希望你拥有分叉（fork）并打造你想要的编辑器所需的一切。

paragraphs.en: T3 Code currently supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Antigravity. Install and authenticate at least one provider before use:
paragraphs.zh: T3 Code 目前支持 Codex、Claude、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Antigravity。 使用前请安装并完成至少一个提供商的身份验证：

sents.en: T3 Code currently supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Antigravity.
sents.zh: T3 Code 目前支持 Codex、Claude、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Antigravity。

sents.en: Install and authenticate at least one provider before use:
sents.zh: 使用前请安装并完成至少一个提供商的身份验证：

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh On Windows, in PowerShell:
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh
```

在 Windows 上，在 PowerShell 中：

paragraphs.en: irm https: // t3.codes / install.ps1 | iex Then run t3 to start the server and open the local web app. t3 service install keeps it running in the background, t3 update moves to a newer release, and t3 --help has the full reference.
paragraphs.zh: irm https: // t3.codes / install.ps1 | iex 然后运行 t3 启动服务器并打开本地 Web 应用。t3 service install 可让其在后台持续运行，t3 update 可升级到更新的版本，t3 --help 提供完整的参考文档。

paragraphs.en: To try it once without installing, run npx t3@latest instead.
paragraphs.zh: 如果想在不安装的情况下试用一次，可以运行 npx t3@latest。

paragraphs.en: Install the latest version of the desktop app from GitHub Releases , or from your favorite package registry:
paragraphs.zh: 从 GitHub Releases 安装最新版本的桌面应用，或从你喜欢的软件包仓库安装：

paragraphs.en: winget install T3Tools.T3Code Windows ( scoop ) scoop install extras/t3code macOS (Homebrew) brew install --cask t3-code Debian, Ubuntu ( .deb ) Download the .deb from GitHub Releases , then:
paragraphs.zh: winget install T3Tools.T3Code Windows ( scoop ) scoop install extras/t3code macOS (Homebrew) brew install --cask t3-code Debian, Ubuntu ( .deb ) 从 GitHub Releases 下载 .deb 文件，然后执行：

paragraphs.en: sudo apt install ./T3-Code- * .deb Arch Linux (AUR) Stable:
paragraphs.zh: sudo apt install ./T3-Code- * .deb Arch Linux (AUR) 稳定版：

paragraphs.en: yay -S t3code-nightly-bin The AUR packaging is maintained in this repository under packaging/aur .
paragraphs.zh: yay -S t3code-nightly-bin AUR 打包维护于本仓库的 packaging/aur 目录下。

paragraphs.en: We are very very early in this project. Expect bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在这个项目上还处于非常早期的阶段。请预期会有 bug。

paragraphs.en: We are (mostly) not accepting contributions yet. Small fixes may be considered. Big features will not be.
paragraphs.zh: 我们（基本上）暂不接受贡献。 小的修复可能会被考虑。 大型功能则不会。

paragraphs.en: T3 Code uses Vite+ so you'll need to install the global vp command-line tool.
paragraphs.zh: T3 Code 使用 Vite+，因此你需要安装全局的 vp 命令行工具。

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | bash Windows irm https://vite.plus/ps1 | iex Checkout their getting started guide for more information: https://viteplus.dev/guide/
paragraphs.zh: curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | bash Windows irm https://vite.plus/ps1 | iex 查看其入门指南了解更多信息：https://viteplus.dev/guide/
